data.name: Heavenly Book
data.detailed_description:
The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny as a Martial Arts Legend

A simple office worker accidentally crosses into the mysterious world of
"The Book of Heaven."
In this world full of martial arts and fantasy,
you will face countless challenges, explore unknown lands,
and uncover your true destiny.

Every decision may change your future.
Become a hero destined to rewrite your fate.

Game Features

  • Alchemy System:
    Master the way of alchemy, control the mystical herbs of the world, and forge your own divine elixirs.
    Every potion crafted is a challenge to your destiny, helping you enhance your strength and pave the way for adventure.

  • Star Wheel System:
    The stars guide you, and fate spins its wheel.
    Every turn of the star wheel writes your fate, and the choices you make will lead to different futures.

  • Free Combat System:
    Draw your sword and fight alongside your companions.
    The free combat system brings endless possibilities to every battle, with the battlefield becoming a martial arts legend filled with flashing blades.

  • Story Choice System:
    Between light and darkness, the choice is in your hands.
    Every decision will rewrite your destiny.
    Whether you walk the path of righteousness or embrace the shadows, embark on a journey that is uniquely yours.

  • Starstone Inlay System:
    Earn starstones based on your choices.
    Each starstone enhances your abilities,
    giving you an edge in the battle between good and evil.

  • Five Elements and Five Attributes System:
    The five elements balance and counter each other,
    while the five attributes interact in strategic ways.
    Master the power of the five elements,
    and cleverly use attribute interactions to dominate every battle.

Explore the Path of Immortality, and Create Your Own Legend

Every step you take is a key to your future.
In the world of "The Book of Heaven," face endless trials,
break through your limits, and forge a legend that belongs to you.

data.short_description: The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny, Your Path A regular office worker stumbles into The Book of Heaven. Explore vast lands, face trials, and uncover your destiny. Your choices shape your future — hero or villain, light or shadow. An epic journey awaits. The Book of Heaven is open — destiny awaits.

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
